description: Source code for the AudioTrackBridge class, which manages audio playback via JNI on Android, including creation, control, and data writing for audio tracks.

classes.name: AudioTrackBridge
classes.description: A class that manages Android audio track playback via JNI, including creation, control (play, pause, stop), volume adjustment, timestamp retrieval, and data writing.

methods.name: AudioTrackBridge
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the audio track bridge with specified parameters, creates JNI objects, and allocates buffers.

methods.name: ~AudioTrackBridge
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up JNI references and destroys the audio track bridge.

methods.name: GetMinBufferSizeInFrames
methods.description: Static method to retrieve the minimum buffer size in frames for given sample type, channels, and sampling frequency.

methods.name: PauseAndFlush
methods.description: Pauses and flushes the audio buffer, discarding unplayed data.

methods.name: WriteSample
methods.description: Writes float samples to the audio track.

methods.name: WriteSample
methods.description: Writes 16-bit samples to the audio track, with optional synchronization time.

methods.name: WriteSample
methods.description: Writes 8-bit samples to the audio track, with optional synchronization time.

methods.name: GetAudioTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the current audio timestamp and frame position.

methods.name: GetAndResetHasAudioDeviceChanged
methods.description: Checks and resets the flag indicating if the audio device has changed.

methods.name: GetUnderrunCount
methods.description: Returns the number of underruns during playback.

methods.name: GetStartThresholdInFrames
methods.description: Returns the start threshold in frames for the audio track.
